query:
INSERT INTO group_members (group_id, user_id, added_by)
            SELECT $1, $2, NULL
            WHERE EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM user_groups g
                JOIN users u ON u.id = $2
                WHERE g.id = $1 AND g.tenant_id = $3 AND u.tenant_id = $3
            )
            ON CONFLICT (group_id, user_id) DO NOTHING
